meta.name: securability-engineering-review
meta.description: Score a codebase, file, or merge request against the FIASSE v1.0.4 SSEM model — 0-10 per attribute, equal-weighted pillars, evidence-backed strengths and weaknesses, prioritized recommendations, 50-item checklist appendix. Trigger on "review/score/audit securability", "SSEM scorecard", "FIASSE/SSEM compliance", "where would I start hardening this?", "is this audit-ready?", "security posture baseline" — including phrasings that don't say SSEM explicitly. For requirements use prd-securability-enhancement; for new code use securability-engineering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给代码库或合并请求做安全评分，找出薄弱环节
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码安全做系统性评估并得到改进建议
copy.tagline_en: Score codebase or merge request for security, find weaknesses
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a systematic security assessment of your code with actionable recommendations

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能对代码库、文件或合并请求进行安全工程评分，输出 0-10 分的 SSEM 评分卡，包含证据支持的优缺点、优先级建议和 50 项检查清单。
howto.when: 当你要求审查、评分或审计代码的安全性，或询问“如何加固代码”、“是否审计就绪”时触发。

say.text: 请审查这个项目的安全工程质量。
say.note: Claude 会生成 SSEM 评分报告。

say.text: 给这个合并请求做安全工程评分。
say.note: Claude 会分析代码变更并输出评分卡。

say.text: 这个代码库的安全基线是什么？
say.note: Claude 会评估并给出安全态势基线。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can score a codebase, file, or merge request against the FIASSE v1.0.4 SSEM model, producing a 0-10 per-attribute scorecard with evidence-backed strengths, weaknesses, prioritized recommendations, and a 50-item checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to review, score, or audit securability, or ask "where would I start hardening this?", "is this audit-ready?", or "security posture baseline".

say_en.text: Review the securability of this project.
say_en.note: Claude will produce an SSEM scorecard.

say_en.text: Score this merge request for securable engineering.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the diff and output a scorecard.

say_en.text: What is the security posture baseline for this codebase?
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate and provide a baseline.
